lines.trans: Arrogant men like Chun Yuqiao are something I have seen plenty of.
He always thinks he can control everything onstage and behind the scenes.

words.gram: Meaning: onstage and behind the scenes.

lines.trans: If you do not teach someone like that a lesson, he only grows more reckless.
I did not do all that solely to stand up for you.
Inviting me to the Star Night gala was not his idea either, I think.
Ever since Li Mingji's incident, the network has had people watching Xingtian, and ties are tense.
Chun Yuqiao's bad reputation has already spread, making life hard for him at Xingtian too.
